answer_1.quote: Due to high annotation costs, existing work proposes to synthesize target-domain QA pairs via neural question generation (QG) models.

answer_2.quote: Other work considers using the generation log likelihood by the QG model (LM Score) as a metric to filter noisy questions.

answer_4.quote: Three annotators work independently and we adopt the majority vote for deciding the final labels of a generated QA pair (if disagreement appears).
answer_4.guideline: If the generated question is simpler than the ground truth, then it would be marked as "trivial"; otherwise, it is a "non-trivial" one.
